SprigDB's own errors use numbers 39000–39999. MySQL and MariaDB clients receive the number and SQLSTATE; MongoDB clients receive the same number with the `codeName`; the REST API answers with the HTTP status and the gRPC API with the status shown. Errors marked retryable are safe to retry as they are. Some drivers show these numbers as negative (a signed 16-bit value): add 65536.

318 codes.
